# F0001 — Create item

Status: ready
Source: owner:demo, 2026-11-13

## Overview

A member creates an item so it appears in their list.

## Description

### Creating an item

The member enters a name and saves. A name is required and must be unique.

### Opening selected items

The member selects one or more items. The selected Items are that current
collection. Preferences set `editor` to `Plain text editor`; this preference is
the configured editor. The member opens the selected Items for editing.

## Out of scope

- Editing an item after the editor closes.
